# Jacketee

> Jacketee is an online store for varsity, bomber, leather, puffer, and other jackets, with custom colors, patches, embroidery, and bulk order options.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://www.jacketee.com/)
- [Shop](https://www.jacketee.com/shop)
- [Varsity jackets](https://www.jacketee.com/varsity-jackets)
- [Bulk orders](https://www.jacketee.com/bulk-orders)
- [Materials and colors](https://www.jacketee.com/materials-colors)
- [Patches and embroidery](https://www.jacketee.com/patches-embroidery)
- [Size guide](https://www.jacketee.com/size-guide)
- [Blog](https://www.jacketee.com/blog)
- [FAQ](https://www.jacketee.com/faq)
- [Shipping information](https://www.jacketee.com/shipping)
- [Returns and exchanges](https://www.jacketee.com/returns)
- [Contact](https://www.jacketee.com/contact)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.jacketee.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of service](https://www.jacketee.com/terms-of-service)

## Guidance

Use public Jacketee pages as the source of truth for current product, policy, shipping, and support information. Do not expose private account, checkout, admin, order, or API data.
